workflow_runs.name: Native VST3
workflow_runs.display_title: Merge indexed fixture admission and accepted console evidence

head_commit.message:
Merge indexed fixture admission and accepted console evidence

Preserve both the published indexed Windows repair and the independently
qualified local candidate with all sixty accepted worker records.

Keep published H1/P1 source-transition schemas, separate immutable original
and active canonical-reader identities, retain every published test body,
and add bounded failure-only P1 diagnostics.

Record first-only 71/41 source suites, three native reader passes, final
repository integrity, independent reviews, all original failures and the
published predecessor's complete sixteen-job success. Production, visual
criteria, deadlines and workflows remain unchanged. Final merged-source
hosted qualification remains separate.
